name: React Native
run: npx react-native run-ios   (or: npx react-native run-android)
leftForYou: Install the iOS pods and rebuild the app: run 'npx pod-install', then build it again. The SDK has native code.
Connect the App Store or Google Play and map your products to store products before you sell for real: 'voidhash provider --help'. Until then, debug builds simulate purchases.
